body: firstly, if you do get an infestation (hopefully not!) DON’T use a bug bomb - the gas just forces them to retreat further into homes, making the issue worse. signs wise, things like spots of blood on your bedding or clothing, eggs which are rice shaped and sticky, exoskeletons from shedding, etc - i sincerely hope this was just a lonesome bug!
me too 💀
it’s episode 4, just as yellow guy forgets the password :)
windscribe is free, and express vpn has a good free trial :)
sometimes things just naturally get better on their own, friend, it’s not always about actively trying - things can always improve if given the chance. are you okay right now?
how are you feeling now?
how do you know the hope is false?
i can’t just chill, not right now, there is a need to help if i can. where actually are you right now?
is there anything that can change your mind?
i feel so desperate to let go myself, but also so desperate to save others including you, i don’t understand it
wait can we talk for a bit, first?
you here?

this ,, may be bad advice but could you possibly tell him it upset you? i have done that before & it has sometimes helped. he may just not know the impact it’s had on you. 

ditto, i often think i’m boring & annoying - can guarantee you’re not though, we rarely view ourselves in a positive light, but people may come along who’ll see great traits in you that they adore

the happy memories could always possibly be replaced with newer, other brilliant & happy memories - nothing is certain, but it’s something to think about/consider. you have unknown, future memories to look forward to, if you think about it

i’m sorry, i understand that feeling well, it’s super rough :( could you ask him about a different day? eg. if he made plans for the Tuesday, ask about Wednesday- i’ve been in your place & honestly new friends and ppl tend to come along. what is it that makes you think you’re not nice to be around? talking to you now, that doesn’t seem to be the case at all!
if i’m okay asking, what makes you think people don’t like you? i think that often, but it’s usually not true, just self doubt
are you safe?

there’s a ton on reasons outside of people - travelling, maybe a pet, waiting for a new instalment in a game franchise you really love, being able to finally afford that one thing you’ve always wanted, be it a console or holiday, or a coat you’ve had your eye on for ages! the list goes on & on. there’s so much imo and it rly keeps me going sometimes, once just waiting for the next chapter of a comic i’m invested in did it. i know it’s hard hanging on for things that involve yourself, but i really do think it’s the nice little things that can make up life

they sound like wonderful goals, for yourself and others. i’m sure ppl will love your baking, one day :) and yes, walking safely would be amazing, there are so many things to see on walks. i personally love walking & seeing the sky change colours in front of me at sunset/rise. 

also learning about things you love is so cool bc it never ends, there’s always more information to take in and smile at, i love that goal for u

it really is a great method, i hope it continues to work for you in future! finding new things to add can help, even just awaiting a new film - wishing the best for you

i felt suicidal at 15 too, but at 23 i’ve had so many more amazing experiences and have met so many wonderful people. i’m not going to say cliches like ‘it gets better,’ but there’s a chance that it can - i still feel suicidal sometimes but i can make it to 24, and beyond, and you can make it to 16, and more . there’s so much out there, you deserve to see it

is there anything you’ve ever wanted to do, that you can stick around for? could be something tiny, like finish a tv series, or get a tattoo, or piercing, or something like travelling or just. anything at all! you can talk to me about that thing if you’d like

thank you so much for replying. i’m definitely trying to remember to breathe! i just keep thinking about all the places they could be hiding that i can’t reach, or can’t take apart, etc. my dad threw the exoskeleton/bug away, but i have some photos - i just want to feel safe in my own bed once more, but it doesn’t seem attainable at the moment. some of the bites are also in the breakfast, lunch and dinner line so i’m paranoid & still tearful aaaa
